trainingPage.emptyAllDesc: Enrolling in a gig does not create a training by itself: the company must publish a training for that gig (status active, rehearsal, or completed). The list can stay empty even if the Marketplace shows “Enrolled”.
trainingPage.emptyGigTitle: No trainings for this gig yet.
trainingPage.emptyGigOk: The training service responded successfully but has no published journeys for this gig. Your org may still be preparing content, the journey may still be in draft, or the journey may be linked to a different gig id than the one in the Marketplace. All journeys linked to this gig are shown, including draft/not published.

trainingPage.emptyGigRetry: Select the gig again or refresh the page. If this persists, verify the training API URL and that you are signed in.
